name: AWS SNS
description: Send text messages through Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS).

fields.name: authType
fields.description: How to authenticate with AWS: using static credentials or by assuming an IAM role.

fields.name: accessKeyId
fields.description: The AWS access key ID. Required when the authentication type is 'credentials'.

fields.name: secretAccessKey
fields.description: The AWS secret access key. Required when the authentication type is 'credentials'.

fields.name: roleArn
fields.description: The ARN of the IAM role to assume. Required when the authentication type is 'assumeRole'.

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: The external ID used when assuming the IAM role. Required when the authentication type is 'assumeRole'.

fields.name: awsSNSRegion
fields.description: The AWS region the SNS service is configured in.

fields.name: awsEndpoint
fields.description: A custom endpoint for the SNS API. Leave empty to use the default AWS endpoint.

fields.name: originationNumber
fields.description: The phone number that text messages are sent from.

fields.name: senderId
fields.description: The sender ID shown as the origin of the text messages, where supported.

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: The entity ID used for regulatory registration, where required.

fields.name: templateId
fields.description: The template ID used for regulatory registration, where required.
